purpose: Defines the pending authorization response fields (PA-RL- prefix) copied under 01 PENDING-AUTH-RESPONSE in COPAUA0C. COPAUA0C fills them in 6000-MAKE-DECISION and STRINGs them (with the approved amount re-edited) into a comma-delimited reply sent by MQPUT1 to the requester's reply queue; the code, reason and approved amount are also stored in the PAUTDTL1 detail.

key_fields.name: PA-RL-CARD-NUM
key_fields.meaning: Card number echoed from the request.

key_fields.name: PA-RL-TRANSACTION-ID
key_fields.meaning: Transaction id echoed from the request.

key_fields.name: PA-RL-AUTH-ID-CODE
key_fields.meaning: Authorization id code (set to the request auth time).
